Получение радиофакс-карты

Confirmation that a complete facsimile weather chart has been successfully received via HF radio and is ready for navigation use.

Definition

Confirmation that a complete facsimile weather chart has been successfully received via HF radio and is ready for navigation use.

Operational example

Bridge to radio officer: confirm radiofax chart receipt for North Atlantic surface analysis, ensure clarity and file for route planning, over.
